items.statement: The imported baseline passes the repository quality gate from its committed lockfile.
Core and CLI packages can be packed and installed by the baseline smoke checks.
CI, CodeQL, and Scorecard succeed with read-only default workflow permissions.
The human product contract, ADR, package boundaries, and machine plan make the same V1 scope decisions.
The plan, ledger, state, evidence, progress, and scenario files validate and cross-reference without drift.
The golden contract covers success, ambiguity, incompatibility, regression, stale source, provider failure, privacy, and idempotency.
The full repository quality gate passes and the change contains planning infrastructure only.
Compiled task packets preserve each task's reviewed product capabilities and declare delivery authority separately.
Single-maintainer delivery keeps exact candidate and gate evidence, redaction, and CI enforcement without CODEOWNERS or reviewer-evidence blocking promotion.
The golden-scenario skill has an explicit offline-only fixture boundary and routes V1-02 through deterministic semantic assertions without acceptance or merge authority.

A separate maintainer-controlled task records two consumed V1-02 attempts and authorizes exactly one remaining attempt for five exact plan-embedded review findings, with no product-scope or capability expansion.
A separate maintainer-controlled task authorizes only the still-unaccepted third V1-02 attempt to add recursive durable-artifact redaction scanning and a separately controlled promotion.
Every V1 artifact has a versioned strict schema and canonical serializer.
Malformed, unknown-version, and logically impossible artifacts fail closed with actionable diagnostics.
Core has no filesystem, network, provider, GitHub, or AST dependency.
Durable artifacts exclude credentials and raw protected prompts or outputs by construction.
The fixture contains a supported application, human-owned manifest, and at least 30 reviewed eval cases.
The pinned catalog, clock, and mock provider make every golden scenario reproducible without network access.
The mock provider exercises success, invalid output, timeout, rate limit, usage, retry, and budget behavior.
Sentinel credentials and protected model output never appear in test logs or durable artifacts.
Supported direct OpenAI-compatible TypeScript call sites are discovered with normalized model pins and source fingerprints.
High-confidence discovery precision is at least 95% over the reviewed corpus.
Supported-pattern recall is at least 80% over the reviewed corpus.
Dynamic and ambiguous wrappers are reported without a patchable target or invented semantic ID.
Manifest initialization requires explicit human-owned stable call-site IDs, ownership metadata, and a human-reviewed representative prompt/completion token-weight profile with provenance.
Re-scanning and re-initializing an unchanged call site is idempotent.
Invalid or colliding stable IDs are rejected without partially updating the manifest.
OpenRouter catalog data is normalized into a versioned immutable snapshot with provenance and digest.
Compatibility and price filters fail closed on unknown or incomplete provider metadata.
Replaying a snapshot after live catalog changes produces identical candidate ordering and price calculations.

After hard compatibility and policy filters, candidate resolution applies a default maximum of five, permits only a lower repository-configured bound, computes exact-decimal projected workload cost from catalog prices and the manifest's pinned representative prompt/completion token weights, then ranks cost ascending, context limit descending, and canonical model ID ascending.

An unchanged normalized catalog content digest reuses its immutable snapshot while recording a new immutable refresh observation; a failed live refresh reports failure and never represents a prior snapshot as current.
The canonical vetryn eval command emits reproducible run and candidate artifacts from pinned inputs.
Schema, required-fact, protected-segment, cost, latency, context, and privacy gates are deterministic and fail closed.
Provider retries, concurrency, timeouts, and spend are bounded and reported.
Partial, exhausted, or privacy-unsafe runs cannot be promoted to recommendation input.
A recommendation requires all hard gates, the configured quality threshold, minimum evidence, and a material economic opportunity.
Invalid, incompatible, insufficient-evidence, and quality-regressing candidates produce explicit abstentions.
JSON and Markdown reports describe the same deltas, failures, confidence, provenance, and estimated savings.
No abstention or failed hard gate can produce an actionable patch plan.
A valid recommendation changes only the reviewed model literal and preserves formatting and unrelated syntax.
Stale fingerprints, ambiguous targets, or changed preconditions refuse the patch and request a rescan.
Applying or generating the same patch twice is idempotent.
Patch evidence links the source fingerprint, accepted recommendation, model change, and exact diff.
The composite Action runs the supported workflow from a clean external fixture using packed CLI artifacts.
Workflow permissions are least privilege and third-party Actions are pinned by full commit SHA.
Failed and abstained runs publish evidence but cannot open a migration PR.
An unchanged rerun reuses recommendation identity and does not duplicate PR output only when the referenced evidence is complete, integrity-valid, and reusable under current policy.

Provider-backed assessment is manual by default, scheduling requires explicit repository opt-in, evaluator executable identity is bound into the evaluation-input digest, and unchanged digests skip paid candidate execution only when prior evidence is complete, integrity-valid, and reusable under current policy.
At least ten qualified recommendation PRs are observed across at least three independent companies.
At least 40% of qualified recommendation PRs merge within fourteen days.
No observed rollout causes a serious quality, safety, privacy, or operational regression.
Evidence demonstrates attributable savings or quality value and records onboarding effort without raw customer prompts or outputs.

Sanitized field evidence records exactly one outcome: positive valuable open-ended call sites blocked specifically because deterministic evaluation cannot establish semantic non-inferiority; representative no-findings after a predeclared eligibility census and direct assessment of at least ten eligible open-ended call sites across at least three FIELD-001 companies; or insufficient coverage with the denominator, exclusions, and missing coverage recorded. Coverage and exclusions require independent review, and only the positive outcome may justify semantic-scorer design.
